title: Monotonicity of the uniform norm
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite set, let $q>0$, and let $f,g:\\Omega\\to\\mathbb R$. If $|f(x)|\\le |g(x)|$ for every $x\\in\\Omega$, then the uniform $L^q$ norm of $f$ is at most that of $g$.
